title: Construction and validation of a robust prognostic model based on immune features in sepsis.

models.verbatim_formula: risk score = sum(coef_i x expression_i) over 22 DEIRGs (formula itself given in Supplementary Table 7, not downloaded)
models.expression_scale_used: unclear (GSE65682 series matrix; limma used for DEGs; no explicit transformation stated)
models.cutoff: median risk score in training set (239 high / 240 low)
models.reported_performance: Training GSE65682 (n=479 sepsis): 28-day mortality AUC 0.879 (survivalROC), KM P=1.105e-13. External: E-MTAB-4451 AUC 0.805; E-MTAB-5273 0.783; E-MTAB-5274 0.913; GSE95233 0.917; GSE106878 0.796; GSE63042 0.915
models.source_location: Results 'Construction of prognostic model' + Table 2 (multivariate Cox coef/HR); Figure 5-6

notes: Coefficients are multivariate Cox coefs from Table 2 (several with p>0.05 retained). Discussion lists MPO as a high-risk gene but Table 2 coef for MPO is negative (-0.615); Table 2 value recorded. Validation n_used is the 'total patients' column of Table 1 (exact n analysed per validation set not stated). Methods text misprints GSE63042 as 'GSE63062'; Figure 2A caption misprints GSE66890. Training n=479 sepsis patients of GSE65682 (DEGs computed in GSE65682 sepsis vs control). Nomogram also combined genes with clinical features (age etc.), not recorded as a separate model.
